definitions.gloss: block script, regular script, standard script
definitions.explanation: A style of writing Chinese characters (kanji) in which each stroke is clearly and separately formed, without cursive connections. The most standard and legible of the traditional calligraphy styles.

examples.japanese: {楷書|かいしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write carefully in block script.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{楷書|かいしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: In calligraphy, practice begins with block script.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公的|こうてき}→公的：06349_kouteki⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{楷書|かいしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Official documents often require entries to be written in block script.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the five traditional styles of Chinese calligraphy. {楷書|かいしょ} is the most standard and readable style, making it the default for formal documents and the starting point for calligraphy students. When filling out official forms in Japan, instructions often specify {楷書|かいしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in block script).

RELATED SCRIPTS:
- ⟦{行書|ぎょうしょ}→行書：19195_gyousho⟧: semi-cursive script (partially connected strokes)
- ⟦{草書|そうしょ}→草書：19196_sousho⟧: cursive script (highly abbreviated, flowing)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楷書|かいしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in block script
- {楷書|かいしょ}⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧: block script style
- {楷書|かいしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in using block script
